from PyQt5 import QtWidgets, QtGui, uic, QtCore

import os
import requests
import subprocess
import logging

from appdata import AppDataPaths


class LoginWindow(QtWidgets.QDialog):
    def __init__(self):
        super(LoginWindow, self).__init__()
        
        uic.loadUi('login.ui', self)
        
        self.button_login.clicked.connect(self.api_check)
        self.button_login_2.clicked.connect(self.open_home_page)
        
        self.app_data = AppDataPaths("Pixel Led Animator")
        self.app_data.setup()

        version = '2.2.5'

        logo_pixmap = QtGui.QPixmap('logo.png')
        self.graphicsView_logo.setPixmap(logo_pixmap)
        
        self.setWindowTitle("Pixel Led Animator {}".format(version))
        self.setWindowIcon(QtGui.QIcon('icon.ico'))

        self.show()
        
        self.check_update()

        self.setup_export_folder()
        self.load_saved_credentials()
        
    def check_update(self):
        try:
            response = requests.get('http://pixel-led-animator.com/API/version.txt')
        except:
            logging.error("Connection Error")
            self.button_login.setText("Update Server Error")
        
        if response.text > version:
            ret = QtWidgets.QMessageBox.question(self, 'Update Available', "New version: {} - click yes to update.".format(response.text),
                                                 QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.No)
            if ret == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes:
                webbrowser.open('http://pixel-led-animator.com/API/update.php')
                self.close()
        else:
            logging.info("No Update Available current version: " + version)
            
    def setup_export_folder(self):
        for rel_path in ["export", "export/sequencer", "export/combiner"]:

            if not os.path.exists(export_path):
                os.makedirs(export_path)
